content:
maria: kicking off schema migration for messages.v2 -> messages.v3 (backfill + FK). Deploybot kicked it off. quiet window is 23:00-01:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] migration start: migration_id=2026-03-msgs-v3, canary=5%, targets=prod, started_by=maria

aj: saw canary succeed on 5 hosts. progressing to 30% now.

maria: running backfill. noticing some long table locks on replicas, nothing on primary yet. attaching short sample logs.

maria: ```
2026-03-20T23:05:12Z LOCK ACQUIRED table=messages backfill_batch=42 duration=00:00:12
2026-03-20T23:06:33Z LOCK WAIT table=messages backfill_batch=43 wait=00:02:30
``` 

sophia: @maria can you capture which statement is blocking? is it an index build or an FK check?

maria: looks like FK validation on messages_thread_id -> threads.id from the backfill job. batch size is 10k rows.

kevin: flagging SRE runbook: if backfill stalls >5m on >2 hosts, reduce batch_size and retry, if still stuck after 15m initiate abort and rollback.

aj: rolling back is costly — can we try pause writes to the partition and resume? can we pin old consumer version while we heal?

maria: plan: 1) scale batch_size -> 1k, 2) pause consumer-write-lambda for affected shards (ETA 2m), 3) re-run batches, 4) monitor. rollback if any host stuck >15m after retries.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] update: migration progress set to paused for hosts 3-7, action=change_batch_size

sophia: I'll run the pause script: `./ops/pause-consumer --shards=12-20` and watch offsets. posting when done.

sophia: paused consumers for shards 12-20 :white_check_mark:

maria: resubmitting backfills with batch_size=1000. starting staggered resume.

aj: pinning service version for readers/writers to v2.9.1 for the window. release notes updated: "Rollback safe state pinned to v2.9.1".

kevin: monitoring dashboard: tokenized latency spikes at 23:09 but within SLO. will escalate if errors >0.5%.

maria: so far batches moving. will keep on-call loop open for 30m. if any host shows `LOCK WAIT > 600s` we'll abort and open rollback ticket.

aj: thanks team. posting an update to #all-hands with short note after we close the window.

maria: update 23:22 UTC — backfills finished on hosts 1-9, hosts 10-12 still resuming but no locks. marking thread for postmortem.

kevin: good job. saving logs and creating followup runbook entry about reducing FK validation batch sizes for large-tenanted tables.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] migration complete: migration_id=2026-03-msgs-v3 status=partial_completed hosts_completed=9 hosts_pending=3
